app.archiveText: The project “{{name}}” will be hidden from the list and cannot be opened or changed. The data is kept; the project can be restored at any time.

overview.label: Overview
overview.description: Project data, current jobs, models and computer load.

variants.label: Variants
variants.description: Shared display variants of objects for the whole project.

classes.label: Classes
classes.description: Objects to recognize and their images by variant.

backgrounds.label: Backgrounds
backgrounds.description: Ready backgrounds or video frames the size of the model input.

generation.label: Generation
generation.description: Placing objects on backgrounds with the given variant shares.

images.label: Images
images.description: Frames to view and annotate: imported or generated.

datasets.label: Datasets
datasets.description: Immutable versions of ready frames and annotation.

training.label: Training
training.description: Training the model on a built dataset and its versions with a passport.

models.label: Models
models.description: All model versions of the project: passports, weights and the working version.

checks.label: Checks
checks.description: Running models on an image, a dataset, a video and the screen.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Comparing model versions: metrics, training curves and dataset checks.

library.title: Projects
library.subtitle: Select a task to open its materials and settings.
library.importHint: Add a project from an archive saved on another computer
library.loadFailed: The projects could not be loaded. Load them again.
library.exportHint: Save the project with all materials, datasets and model weights to one file
library.notFoundHint: Change the search or show the archive.
library.emptyText: A project brings together the classes, object variants, images and datasets of one task. It needs an installed base model.

transfer.hint: A large project may take several minutes to transfer; you can work with other projects.
transfer.cancelled: The operation was cancelled. Nothing changed.
transfer.exportDone: The archive is saved. Move the file to another computer and choose “Import a project…”.
transfer.importDone: The project is added to the library.
transfer.exportInterrupted: The export was interrupted. Repeat the export.
transfer.importInterrupted: The import was interrupted. Repeat the import.

projectEditor.description: The input size sets the size of backgrounds, generated frames and datasets.
projectEditor.name: Name
projectEditor.installFirst: Install a model in the catalog to create a project.
projectEditor.sizeHint: The sizes are multiples of {{stride}}. Existing datasets keep their size.

projectDeletion.title: Delete the project from the computer?
projectDeletion.text: “{{name}}” and all its materials, datasets, training history and trained models will be deleted permanently. Shared base YOLO models and files of other projects are kept. To keep a copy, export the project first.
projectDeletion.reviewFailed: The project jobs could not be checked. Check again.
projectDeletion.activities: Background jobs are running — deletion will cancel them:
projectDeletion.transferActive: A project export is running. Wait until it ends and repeat.
projectDeletion.cleanupNotice: The project is deleted. Some files are still in use; the application will clean them up at the next start.

baseModels.subtitle: Install a model, then select it for a new project. All projects on this computer use the weights.
baseModels.about: Pretrained models for object detection. The internet is needed only to install them. N and Tiny are the most compact variants; L and X need more resources.
baseModels.loadFailed: The model catalog could not be opened. Load it again.
baseModels.deleteHint: Delete the weights from the computer
baseModels.noneInstalledHint: Turn off the filter and install a model from the catalog.
baseModels.notFoundHint: Change the search or select another family.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.text: The annotation changes of this image are not saved yet. Save them before the next action or discard them explicitly.
unsaved.saveFailed: The annotation could not be saved.

deletion.reviewFailed: The dependencies could not be checked. Check again.
